summary: Paysafe Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting held on May 26, 2026. Shareholders elected four Class II directors (Mark Brooker, Dagmar Kollmann, Marianne Heiss, Edward Wertheim) and approved the reappointment of Deloitte Touche as independent auditors for fiscal year 2026, with authority to set remuneration. This is a routine governance filing; no special-situation transaction, activist campaign, or structural change is involved. The report also incorporates the filing by reference into existing registration statements. As a routine meeting results announcement, no further action or risk-arb stance applies.
